desc:
[BUGS ARE FIXED!]

welcome to untitled space game!

you're taking the role of the director and rocket scientist of a space program. you're going to be researching, launching, exploding rockets to get more science. you'll start off small, and progress to huge rockets, even going to the moon! exploring space is your primary goal!

THE GAME IS STILL IN BETA DEVELOPMENT! EXPECT BUGS! if you have any suggestions, feedback or bug reports, you can send it to me in roblox messages, our community server or use /bug in game! updates take at most a few months to release!

current rockets: Nell, V2, Sputnik 1, Sputnik 2, Mercury-Redstone, Mercury-Atlas, Vostok 1, Luna 1, Luna 2, Gemini, Voskhod, Apollo 8, Surveyor, Apollo 11

soon: Manual Landing (50%), Rewrites (DONE), Interiors (40%), Bug Fixes, And More!
